name: Many pages not found from one address
description: An address that asks a web server container or a web server of the host for many pages that do not exist (404) since the last collection: a scanner walking through routes and common file names. Requests for sensitive files and exploit payloads are judged by their own rules.
message: {Count} requests for pages that do not exist from {Source} (last: {Message})
remediation: Rate-limit or block the address at the proxy / firewall, and check that nothing the scanner asked for is reachable (the access log shows 200 instead of 404 for it).
